diagnosis: ReportCachePurgeView executes cacheops invalidate_obj on AnalyticsReport by UUID without verifying that the report belongs to the caller's organization. An unauthorized tenant user can invalidate computationally intensive reports generated by other companies, exhausting server resources during peak reporting cycles.
